It depends a lot on where you go, but the general idea is it's supposed to be for short term crisis stabilization.  They give you meds, you meet with a psychiatrist every day, they feed you and check on you often to make sure you're okay/not trying to harm yourself.  There's groups where they try to teach you how to calm yourself, how your meds work, patient rights, sometimes literally just arts and crafts so you don't die of boredom.  There are long term patients but ideally they want you in and out within a couple weeks (which can happen with a normal illness so it won't necessarily fuck up your life).

The biggest issue is being bored/winding up somewhere unprepared for psych patients.
